tags.gist: Wants the sensitivity of data accessed or processed added as a risk modifier, since a correct output can still harm through unnecessary disclosure.
Wants agentic testing to check that systems access only needed data and tools, including permission boundaries, approval before sensitive actions and auditability.
Wants data minimization, retention limits, access controls and de-identification considered in monitoring, which should not retain every interaction.
Wants material third-party model changes to include data-handling changes such as retention, logging, training use or tool permissions, in notification expectations.
